name: AEM
summary: α-Ethylmescaline (AEM or 3,4,5-trimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine) is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and phenylisobutylamine families related to the psychedelic drug mescaline. It is the analogue of mescaline and TMA with an ethyl group at the α position of the side chain.

pharmacology.text: AEM produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents, but with only about half the potency of mescaline and TMA (α-methylmescaline).
